chapter: Jazz opinions, Jelly Roll and the Rhythm Club
title: Count Basie and Duke Ellington
summary: Basie had the swingiest band; he never talked with Ellington or Basie.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: What about Count Basie? What did you think of his band and so forth?
He got the swingiest band anybody ever heard.
I mean what about it in the 30's?
I don't know that much about it.
What about Duke Ellington in the 30's?
I don't know that much about him.
What was Duke's reputation at this time?
The only time I've seen Duke was on the stage and we made two recordings together. I have never had a conversation with him, he nor Count Basie.
